content.overview: This guideline discusses the management of valvular heart disease, specifically focusing on women with valvular heart disease before and during pregnancy.

subsections.title: 13.1. Initial Management of Women With VHD Before and During Pregnancy
details: It includes guidelines and recommendations for managing women with valvular heart disease during pregnancy.
Cites various studies, including a prospective multicenter study on pregnancy outcomes in women with heart disease (Siu SC, Sermer M, 2001).
Discusses the association between native valvular disease and pregnancy outcomes (Elikayem U, Bitar F, 2005).

subsections.title: 13.1.1. Medical Therapy of Women With VHD Before and During Pregnancy
details: Mentions the ESC guidelines for the management of cardiovascular diseases during pregnancy (Regitz-Zagrosek V, et al., 2018).
